location_fine: autumn city park path and home bedroom
visual_synopsis: In an autumn park a young woman sits on a bench reading while her small son in a blue cap squats on the paved path poking at something with a stick, with passersby walking through; she eventually takes him by the hand and leads him away. The sketch then cuts to a dark bedroom at night where the boy appears in the doorway, comes to the bedside and wakes his sleeping parents, the father still wearing a red sleep mask.
